name: phpDocumentor
what_it_is: phpDocumentor 2 is a tool that makes it possible to generate documentation directly from your PHP source code. Documentation generated by phpDocumentor 2 does not aim to be a replacement for conventional documentation but is rather supplemental, or reference, documentation. Apart from just providing details on what is usable to the consumer from the user interface, phpdoc can provide your consumers with more information regarding the functionality embedded within your source code.
